newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar firms on cenbank dollar sales.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar firms on cenbank dollar sales.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly firmer at 474.25/475.50 per dollar on Monday, compared with 474.75/476.00 on Friday as heavy foreign currency sales by the Central Bank drove the price of foreign currency down, dealers said.
"There was high demand (for currency), but the Central Bank intervened and brought the rate down," one trader said.
Traders said currency demand was felt both from corporate clients, as well as from the inter-bank market.
